review:
Mining Rush is a 7x7 cluster slot set underground, where five or more matching symbols in a cluster pay. In the base game, any winning combination that includes a dynamite scatter turns that scatter into a mine, which stays on the reels for the rest of the round.

Mines collect a point for each win, and three points take them to the next level, making further wins more likely. Three or more scatters trigger up to 20 free spins. The RTP is 96.56%, and Pragmatic Play doesn't list a max win on the page. The mine levels give the game an unusual sense of build-up.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
